key.name: dark-style-slot
key.description: Number of native round buttons placed before the Dark Style button. 0 puts it first, 4 puts it last.

key.name: dnd-slot
key.description: Number of native round buttons placed before the Do Not Disturb button. 0 puts it first, 4 puts it last.

key.name: night-light-slot
key.description: Number of native round buttons placed before the Night Light button. 0 puts it first, 4 puts it last.

key.name: button-order
key.summary: Order of buttons sharing a position
key.description: Index into the list of button orderings used when several of this extension's buttons share the same position.

key.name: slider-thickness-enabled
key.description: When off, the volume and brightness sliders use the theme's default thickness.

key.name: volume-slider-thickness
key.description: Thickness of the volume sliders (output and input) in pixels.

key.name: brightness-slider-thickness
key.description: Thickness of the brightness slider in pixels.
